To find out how many inches the crocodile will grow in 13 years, we first determine its annual growth rate.

1.  **Calculate the growth per year:**
    The crocodile grows 8 inches in 4 years.
    Growth per year = $8 \text{ inches} \div 4 \text{ years} = 2 \text{ inches per year}$.

2.  **Calculate the growth over 13 years:**
    Since the crocodile grows at a rate of 2 inches per year, we multiply this rate by the number of years.
    Growth in 13 years = $2 \text{ inches/year} \times 13 \text{ years} = 26 \text{ inches}$.

Alternatively, you can use a proportion:
$\frac{8 \text{ inches}}{4 \text{ years}} = \frac{x \text{ inches}}{13 \text{ years}}$
$4x = 8 \times 13$
$4x = 104$
$x = \frac{104}{4}$
$x = 26$

FINAL_ANSWER: 26
